ios.desc:
SEE MORE IN LOW-VISIBILITY SCENES.

ClearView Lite is a real-time camera enhancement app designed to improve visibility in fog, haze, rain and low-contrast conditions.
Processing happens directly on your iPhone, allowing you to reveal scene detail while preserving the original visual information — without cloud processing or external editing.

KEY FEATURES
-Real-time visibility enhancement
-Fog and haze reduction
-Low-contrast detail enhancement
-Live camera preview
-Simple one-tap processing
-On-device image processing
-No account required
-No ads
-No subscription

ClearView Lite is the free entry point to the ClearView camera family.

Capture the scene. Enhance the visibility. Keep the image on your device.
